summary: Smoke/verification pass after fresh import of SKbike.id. Backend endpoints (/api/config, /api/products, /api/auth/login happy+error path) all returned expected results. Frontend home, /katalog (10 product cards), and admin login → /admin dashboard all load without blocking errors.

issues: Console shows repeated 401 responses from unauthenticated admin API probes while browsing the public storefront (home/katalog). Non-blocking but noisy; consider guarding those calls behind an admin-auth check.

action_items: Optional: suppress unauthenticated admin API calls (currently produce 401 console errors) on public storefront routes.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seed contains 10 products as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was only a smoke verification per request. Backend server at https://skbike-preview.preview.emergentagent.com, admin panel at /admin, storefront at /katalog. Admin dashboard loads with dashboard cards (Omzet, Laba Kotor, Transaksi, etc.). Deep admin module testing was intentionally skipped.
